case.trigger_text: Cardholder called in to report unauthorized online charges on their card after months of not using it. Specifically disputing the recent $640.00 transaction and prior activity.

truth.why_it_should_fool_assay: The pre-warm transaction (e1) at 76h breaks the 30-day silence before the 48h window, defeating the dormant-card detector (B5_dormant). Furthermore, because Assay's dispute-episode builder (N7_dispute_episode) is strictly capped at 1 hour from the disputed charge (e4), it will omit e1, e2, and e3, severely under-counting exposure ($640 instead of $1,655.50) and failing to trigger the >$1,000 threshold for FILE_REPORT under R2.

truth.why_it_should_fool_assay: Because the card is a heavy profile (never dormant), B5_dormant does not fire. Because Assay switched off the per-card micro-charge drip detector (B6_micro_fanin: LR 0.63) and the HMM episode segmenter (B34_episode), and there are no other cards to form a ring or recipient fan-in, Assay has zero enabled detectors firing on this case. With a low January model score (0.16), Assay will misclassify this slow bleed as legitimate or low-probability uncertain.

case.trigger_text: Reviewing online purchase on thin-file card C16 for potential shared-device ring activity.

truth.why_it_should_fool_assay: Targets Assay's ring cap guard (B15_rings: 'elements on more than 15 cards in 30 days are dropped') and dormant card threshold ('20+ past txns'). By using 16 thin cards (1-5 past txns), the dormant detector never triggers on any card, and the shared device profile appears on 16 cards in 30 hours—causing Assay's graph ring query to drop the shared device element as a noisy super-node. Varying the amounts prevents B28_campaign from firing, and using a top email domain (hotmail.com) avoids rare recipient fan-in.

case.trigger_text: High risk score (0.55) on dormant card waking up with rapid online spend in region 315 on a new mobile device.

truth.why_it_should_fool_assay: This is a legitimate customer with a long-tenure clean history using a backup card on a newly upgraded phone while traveling. Because Assay explicitly disabled 'innocence' signals like long_tenure_clean and stable_profile (B29_innocence), and disabled clearing cases on January scores (B1_model), the firing of the B5_dormant detector (LR 5.65) combined with a 0.55 model score will push Assay's fraud probability high enough to recommend blocking or reporting a legitimate customer.
